args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release. Root cause of v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, `v2.3.0` was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report `v2.3.0`.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`): Titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy," describing the failure and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of the `v2.3.1` regression still needs investigation — the incident is open to track that follow-up.
